card.name: Low/high extremes before 'and lows' pairs
card.fires_on: Words that sit at a point where a contrast of low versus high (or the other extreme) is about to be named, such as 'of' after 'drier regions', 'om' in hypomagnesemia, or 'high' in 'normal to high'. It also fires on 'result' after 'false-negative'.
